"TermAl w-3fe8 wznow, mozemy to przyspieszyc ? Engram w-5b17 tak samo tez tez / WZNOW PRACE, poinformuj Engram::Architect3"
Greg subsequently asked Architect3 directly: "Czemu termal nie znowił pracy?"

Execution of TermAl w-3fe8 and Engram w-5b17, including necessary documentation/migration and applicable checks, is resumed. Do not use the earlier STOP to block these named duties. Physical deletion of gated-control code, ZERO LEGACY; Execution Observability remains independent with project ON/OFF and all-harness coverage. Acceptance evaluation is temporarily OFF, not deleted from code/docs.

A runtime queue pause left by Stop must be released through supported queue/resume by the responsible actor once this actual resume direction applies. A forwarded message alone is not proof a paused worker resumed. Confirm actual queuePaused=false and an executable owner action, without asking Greg to repeat his instruction. Architect3 recovered TermAl Sol-03d4/session-12327 through that route; returned active/queuePaused=false.

Do not infer resumption of canceled unrelated profiling, generic workflows or other stopped work from this named exception alone; follow their actual latest user direction. Existing review, exact-input gate, source/schema/migration and external-action authority still apply. Earlier STOP and narrower exceptions are history in prior revisions.
